fields.value: Interview with Gwen Tauber, on her career as a paintings restorer, Amsterdam, 16 January 2025

dsDescriptionValue.value: As a part of the course Oral History, Gwen Tauber, who recently retired from her career as senior paintings restorer at the Rijksmuseum, was interviewed about the course of her career and her views on the role of the restorer.

fields.value: Interview conducted in the context of the course Oral History and Artwork Life Stories at the University of Amsterdam, an elective as part of the Conservation and Restoration of Cultural Heritage programme.
